name: A2A Bridge (ResonantOS delegation)
author: KyaniteLabs
description: Exposes the local ResonantOS opencode delegation as an A2A 0.2.5 JSON-RPC server on loopback (127.0.0.1:4898). Any A2A client submits a text mission with message/send, polls tasks/get for the lifecycle, and reads the result artifact verbatim when completed; tasks/cancel latches canceled locally. Serve-only: the bridge never dials beyond 127.0.0.1, reuses the browser-first bridge's existing capability tokens (operator-provided), and adds no new capability surface.

grantPresets.label: Local A2A delegation bridge
grantPresets.description: Allow the bridge to serve A2A JSON-RPC on 127.0.0.1:4898 and forward delegations to the browser-first bridge on loopback (127.0.0.1:47773) using the operator-provided RESONANTOS_BROWSER_FIRST_* capability tokens. Serve-only: no destinations beyond loopback are dialed.

tools.name: a2abridge.status
tools.description: Health probe for the bridge: reports service version, the pinned A2A protocol version, the delegation target, and the served JSON-RPC method allowlist. Served on GET /health of the entrypoint (and POST /health with this method envelope); the A2A JSON-RPC surface at POST / intentionally accepts only message/send, tasks/get, and tasks/cancel.
